seed_semantics.canonical: Auto or ExactU32 in0..4294967294; compatibility -1/4294967295 normalize to Auto; no modulo/truncation of other values

required_invariants.literal_data: Every outer request/operation closed. LiteralJSON only fixed semantic fields, full node-selected endpoint/backend-generation parser profile validation before scheduling/effects. Roles/tool schemas/history/metadata remain data, not handlers/grants/paths/URLs or execution permission. No entire generic request document.
required_invariants.source_fidelity: Original source-equivalent cap uses retained serializer/options/raw ingress evidence, all original fields and original escaping; no new IDL wrapper/double escaping charged against old allowance. Counts/digests/profile are checked assertions. Never enlarge old allowance or silently reject near-limit valid content due to new representation overhead.
required_invariants.transport: Source input cap32MiB and UTF8 scalar65536 remain unchanged. Maximal Unicode-boundary chunks imply conservative513/17 count ceilings, not extra bytes. New transport per-frame overhead/count bounds derived separately from actual closed schema and escaping (at most6x UTF8 bytes plus exact envelope); split further within existing transport limits. Automatic staging avoids giant IDL frame, adds no person step.
required_invariants.preparation: Acyclic node-issued preparation/consumer intent precedes staging; it binds fixed purpose, source-limit direction/profile and exact model/conversation/execution. It needs no future OperationId. Finalized documents acquired with preparation consumption and actual operation acceptance atomically. Wrong purpose, generation, expired/revoked or conflicting intent refuses. A legitimate retry of consumed intent returns its original acceptance/outcome under current read authority, never relaunches. Request retry hashes semantic immutable content, not regenerated stage IDs. All staging is automatic transport support.
required_invariants.history_paging: Effects/timings/rank/logprob lists are bounded projection pages, not total1024 history limits. Every page binds immutable content-history ref, first/next index, known/unknown total and completeness; content.read retrieves full retained history. Each history reference is an immutable versioned snapshot: later appends create another version/reference and never mutate a page digest/content. Terminal snapshot cannot fail just because history exceeds one page; no hidden clipping. Node quota/retention/backpressure remains required.
required_invariants.staging: Node-issued IDs are data not capabilities. Exact principal/project/policy+operation/request/model/conversation/content generation binding, stage quota, order/offset/bytes/digest revalidation, immutable atomic finalization plus consumer acquisition, expiry/revocation and private retention required. No replace/delete/cross-request reuse race; cancellation cleans only unreferenced owned stages, not committed effects.
required_invariants.json_parser: Source has no stable separate depth/list/member limit. Explicit structural depth/node count<=encoded byte count plus iterative node parser/schema-validator resource admission required. Reject decoded-equal duplicate keys, invalid UTF8 and escaped lone surrogates. Exact integer semantics, no F64 coercion. Current unsafe/unimplemented parser paths not approved by DTO.
required_invariants.output: Paged/ordered content preserves complete choices/vectors/tool/effect history without new global total clipping. Source output caps are profile-specific. Bounded active node retention/backpressure/privacy and cleanup remain prerequisites, no unbounded storage claim.
required_invariants.generations_retry: Every durable mutation top generation+request_id, exact semantic scope named in authorization. Bind principal/installation/membership/model/project/turn/config/tool-policy generations and immutable payload. Atomic dedupe/user append/turn creation; reauthorize at admission/start/delivery/effect/publication; deletion/revocation denies late result.
required_invariants.lifetime_cancel: Endpoint profile fixes connection-bound disconnect-cancel or separately authorized durable storage/retention. Observer detach does not cancel durable work. One winner vs launch/result/transcript/domain effect commit; exact-owned lease/process settlement before release, no shared-server kill or claimed rollback.
required_invariants.tool_effects: Mandatory execution generation, optional saved turn. Exact current principal/proposal/call/arguments/schema/policy/action receipt binding. Models, providers and external tool results do not grant effects; separate node/provider service authorization.
required_invariants.numeric: Published FiniteF64 for finite public controls/observations; semantic literal JSON retains exact source integer/numeric data under profile parser. Native seed Auto or0..4294967294, no input wrap. Missing/unranked/logprob-unavailable explicit; no fake values, dimensions or implicit provider fallback.
